page: Microsoft Azure EC16ads_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the ECadsv6 server family. It is powered by an AMD processor utilizing the x86_64 architecture and features 16 dedicated vCPUs. The server is provisioned with 128.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU. Virtualization is managed via the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor.

For local storage requirements, the instance includes a bundled 614 GB local SSD. Additionally, the server is designated as Premium Storage capable, allowing integration with high-performance external storage volumes. The configuration does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses or dedicated GPU hardware.

With its high memory density and dedicated CPU allocation, this server type offers qualitative cost efficiency for workloads requiring substantial memory footprints without the overhead of GPU accelerators. The combination of 128.0 GB of RAM and local SSD storage makes it suitable for memory-intensive applications, relational databases, caching layers, and enterprise workloads that benefit from a 1:8 vCPU-to-RAM ratio.
